column2: Under the definition of sin as remaining turned away, after knowledge, from the work of one's own hand, to rebel against God is not necessarily to sin.
Rebellion against God and turning away from God's grace overlap without coinciding: each can occur without the other.
Grace that gives the facing of one's own work as one's own and for what it is can only be received by someone capable of knowing what is right and wrong, though they need not know it beforehand.
